lingbot-va.description: Robbyant’s autoregressive video-action model jointly learns future visual dynamics and robot actions for closed-loop control.

molmoact2.description: Ai2’s action reasoning model connects an embodied vision-language backbone to a continuous flow-matching action expert for robot manipulation.

cosmos-policy.description: NVIDIA’s video-model policy generates robot actions, predicts future states and estimates their value for visuomotor control and planning.

pi0-5.description: Physical Intelligence’s π0.5 builds on π0, using knowledge insulation to improve open-world generalization in a vision-language-action policy.

pi0.description: Physical Intelligence’s flow-based vision-language-action model combines visual observations and language instructions to generate robot actions.

xvla.description: X-VLA uses soft prompts and a flow-matching Transformer to learn robot policies across different embodiments and data sources.

fastwam.description: Fast-WAM co-trains video and action prediction, then generates actions directly at inference without explicitly generating future video.

gr00t-n1-7.description: NVIDIA’s cross-embodiment vision-language-action model pairs a vision-language backbone with a diffusion Transformer that generates continuous actions.

openvla-oft.description: OpenVLA with Optimized Fine-Tuning combines parallel decoding, action chunking and continuous actions trained with an L1 regression objective.

openvla-oft-m.description: The OpenVLA-OFT_m evaluation variant in this benchmark, based on the OpenVLA optimized fine-tuning family. Scores use the supplied completed rollout counts.

openvla-oft-w.description: The OpenVLA-OFT_w evaluation variant in this benchmark, based on the OpenVLA optimized fine-tuning family. Scores use the supplied completed rollout counts.

openvla-oft-plus.description: The OpenVLA-OFT+ evaluation entry in this benchmark. The OFT project introduces FiLM language conditioning in its OFT+ recipe; these scores use the supplied rollout counts.

anchor-align.description: Anchor-Align fine-tunes VLA policies with representation anchoring and language-action alignment to preserve pretrained visual and semantic knowledge.

ript-vla.description: RIPT-VLA post-trains vision-language-action policies through robot interaction, using sparse binary task-success rewards.

openvla.description: OpenVLA is an open 7B vision-language-action model pretrained on robot demonstrations to map images and language instructions to robot actions.

nora.description: NORA is an open generalist vision-language-action model that predicts robot actions from visual observations and language instructions.

univla.description: UniVLA learns task-centric latent actions from cross-embodiment videos, then adapts its generalist policy to robot control and navigation tasks.

pi0-fast.description: Physical Intelligence’s autoregressive vision-language-action model uses FAST action tokenization to generate robot action sequences.
